tools.name: get_menu
tools.description: Returns one kitchen's menu: the dishes and meal packages that can be ordered now, with price, dietary tags, allergen notes, stock, order cutoff, next pickup or delivery time, quantity rules and any required options. tools.name: get_pickup_windows
tools.description: Returns a kitchen's upcoming pickup and delivery times that are open for ordering, each with its order cutoff and the pickup place name. Kitchens with scheduled times list each slot; kitchens with weekly pickup list each pickup time and the dishes it serves. Street addresses are never included.

tools.name: build_order_link
tools.description: Checks that the given dishes can be ordered now in those quantities (stock, cutoff, quantity rules, one shared pickup time) and returns a link to the kitchen's own storefront with them already in the cart. It does not place an order or take payment: the customer reviews and submits the order request
